event_discrimination.ordinary_union: Union hits>0 over registered ordinary traces, preserving each raw identity; all target members must remain zero in that baseline. This selection union is not replacement of per-run raw counts.
event_discrimination.positive: Spec-checker-clean multistep event completed within 384 new physical cycles, each mapped source member actually executed.
causal_controls: Prefix before the registered prerequisite/resolution leaves target sources unhit.
Same-budget control removing the prerequisite or resolution does not hit those source targets.
Separate event families cannot be counted from the same shared stall/reset/ready group.
event_discrimination.claims: Finite ordinary/control non-hits are evidence for the screening gate, not universal unreachability. Formal claims require separately proved assumptions. Plain mode selection is not a multistep target.
